en.name: DeepSeek Harness
en.description: DeepSeek Harness in Textus AI: DeepSeek's own agent reads your folder, writes and edits your notes, and asks before it changes anything.
en.setup: Needs Node.js 24+ and a DeepSeek API key: run npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web once and add the key there.
